newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call meeting on Schiphol night flight ban.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call meeting on Schiphol night flight ban.

text.p: The Dutch Ministry of Transport is calling a meeting for all those concerned about the ban on night flights by wide-body aircraft, proposed by Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport authority.
Schiphol is proposing a ban on DC-10 aircraft and the Boeing 747 in its 100,200, 300 and SP versions, from August 1, between the hours 1100 pm and 0600 am local time (2100 GMT and 0400 GMT).
The meeting will be held next Wednesday, July 23 at 0930 am (0730 GMT) at the Schiphol Auditorium building, near the Schiphol Airport Authority headquarters, on Beekstraat.
After the meeting, which is open to all interested parties, the Dutch government will make its decision on the ban, a transport ministry spokesman said.
